text: Algorithm 1 Inference of Sequence Diffusion 0: Source node u , historical sequence S_{u,t} , prediction time t , candidate set \mathcal{C}_{u,t} , diffusion steps K , parameters \theta \mathbf{X}^{K}_{1:L}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I) . 2: \mathbf{Z}_{1:L}(S_{u,t})=\text{Transformer}(\mathbf{H}_{1:L}(S_{u,t});\mathbf{M}) . for k=K,K-1,\dots,1 do 4: \hat{\mathbf{X}}^{0}_{1:L}=f_{\theta}(\mathbf{Z}_{1:L}(\mathbf{S}_{u,t}),\mathbf{X}_{1:L}^{k},k) . \hat{\mathbf{X}}^{k-1}_{1:L}=\frac{\sqrt{1-\beta^{k}}(1-\bar{\alpha}^{k})}{1-\bar{\alpha}^{k}}\mathbf{X}^{k}_{1:L}+\frac{\alpha^{k-1}\beta^{k}}{1-\bar{\alpha}^{k}}\hat{X}^{0}_{1:L}+\sigma_{k}\epsilon . 6: \mathbf{X}^{k-1}_{1:L}=\hat{\mathbf{X}}^{k-1}_{1:L} . end for 8: Compute scores \hat{\mathbf{y}}_{t} from Equation ( 16 )

Algorithm 2 Training of Sequence Diffusion 0: Batch of interactions \{(u,v,t)\} , parameters \theta 1: for each interaction (u,v,t) in the batch do 2: Construct S_{u,t} and \mathcal{T}_{u,t} 3: \mathbf{Z}_{1:L}(S_{u,t})=\text{Transformer}(\mathbf{H}_{1:L}(S_{u,t});\mathbf{M}) . 4: \mathbf{X}^{0}=\mathbf{H}(\mathcal{T}_{u,t}) . 5: Sample \boldsymbol{\epsilon}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I) . 6: for i=1,2,\dots,L do 7: \mathbf{X}_{i}^{k}=\sqrt{\bar{\alpha}^{k}}\,\mathbf{X}^{0}_{i}+\sqrt{1-\bar{\alpha}^{k}}\boldsymbol{\epsilon}_{i} . 8: end for 9: \hat{\mathbf{X}}^{0}_{1:L}=f_{\theta}(\mathbf{Z}_{1:L}(\mathbf{S}_{u,t}),\mathbf{X}_{1:L}^{k},k) 10: Compute scores \hat{\mathbf{y}}_{t} from Equation ( 16 ) 11: Compute \mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{\text{task}}+\lambda_{\text{diff}}\mathcal{L}_{\text{diff}} . 12: end for 13: Update \theta with gradient descent on \mathcal{L} .
